newsitem.title: INDIA: India considering limit on granite block exports.
newsitem.headline: India considering limit on granite block exports.

text.p: India is considering imposing a limit on exports of granite blocks to tackle a domestic shortage, the Commerce Ministry said in a statement on Friday.

"In response to representations received from many state governments, industry associations and union ministries, the Commerce Ministry is seriously contemplating restrictions on export of dimensional blocks," it said.
The government would try to increase granite availability for processing within India and promote granite exports in a value-added form, it said.
"At present, premium quality blocks are being exported by quarry owners and the established industry is not getting enough raw material for processing," the ministry said.
As a result, the benefits of processing and value-addition accrue to foreign industry rather than domestic business, it said. The government aims to export value-added products, the ministry added.

India's granite and granite products exports in 1995/96 (Arpil-March) are valued at $323.2 million, the statement said. Of these, granite blocks accounted for $170.8 million and polished and processed granite, including tiles, for the rest.
